name: dogfood-payment-crypto-fx-app
description: Dogfood app v1.41-4 — a Coinbase Commerce + BitPay + Wise + Airwallex style stablecoin + on-chain settlement + gas abstraction + FX rate-lock cross-border orchestrator (create crypto invoice + confirm on-chain tx + abstract gas via paymaster/EIP-4337 + link wallet + lock FX rate + initiate SWIFT/SEPA settlement + complete settlement + rate-expiration handling) that drives a crypto-and-FX unified surface backed by @kiwa-lab/payment v0.5 crypto-payment + fx-cross-border semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_CHAIN_RPC + KIWA_FX_URL + KIWA_PAYMASTER_URL + KIWA_SETTLEMENT_URL provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory chain + rate-quote simulation) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/payment @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
